inline_comments.comment: The `dagre-d3-es` dependency is pinned to an exact version (`7.0.13`) rather than a semver range (`^7.0.13`). The project style guide prefers range specifiers over bare exact pins unless there is an explicit, documented reason to lock to a precise version. Since you're already touching this line, consider changing it to `"dagre-d3-es": "^7.0.13"` — the `^` prefix still guarantees at least the CVE-fixed version and lets Renovate Bot pick up future patch releases automatically.

The changeset description uses past tense: `fix: Updated the dagre-d3-es to 7.0.13`. Conventional commit style (and the project's own examples such as `feat: Add ...`) use the imperative mood. Prefer `fix: Update dagre-d3-es to 7.0.13`.
